CreateClusterNodePool.description_en: Creates a node pool for a cluster. DeleteClusterNodePool.description_en: You can call the DeleteClusterNodePool operation to delete a node pool that you no longer need. Before you delete the node pool, ensure that the cluster has sufficient resources for rescheduling

DeleteClusterNodes.description_en: You can call this operation to remove one or more nodes from a cluster. The `ReleaseNode` parameter controls whether to release the underlying ENS compute instance, and its default value is `false`. If a node being removed is in the `failed` state, this parameter is ignored and the corresponding compute instance is released by default. For an ENS compute instance attached via a script from the `DescribeAttachScript` operation, this parameter is also ignored, and the instance is not released by default
DeleteClusterNodes.description_zh:
当您不再需要集群节点继续工作时，可以调用DeleteClusterNodes接口将集群中的节点移出集群。 ReleaseNode参数用于控制是否释放底层ENS计算实例，默认为false。
如果需要删除的node为failed状态，该参数不生效，默认释放对应计算实例。
对于您通过 DescribeAttachScript 接口获取脚本后，自行接入的ENS计算实例，该参数不生效，默认不释放对应计算实例

DescribeReservedResource.description_en: Queries the specifications of resources that you can purchase
DescribeReservedResource.description_zh: 调用DescribeReservedResource查询可购买资源的规格

DescribeSDG.description_en: Retrieves the basic information for a Shared Data Group (SDG), including its node preloading details
DescribeSDG.description_zh: 查询SDG基本信息，包括节点预加载信息等

DescribeSDGSharedDisks.description_en: Queries details for shared disks in a specified SDG
DescribeSDGSharedDisks.description_zh: 可查询指定SDG下的共享盘信息

DescribeSDGs.description_en: Query the information of created shared data groups
DescribeSDGs.description_zh: 查询已创建的共享数据组信息

DescribeSecondaryPublicIpAddresses.description_en: Queries the secondary public IP addresses that have been created
DescribeSecondaryPublicIpAddresses.description_zh: 调用DescribeSecondaryPublicIpAddresses查询已创建的辅助公网IP

DescribeSecurityGroupAttribute.description_en: You can invoke DescribeSecurityGroupAttribute to query the security group rules of a security group
DescribeSecurityGroupAttribute.description_zh: 调用DescribeSecurityGroupAttribute查询一个安全组的安全组规则

DescribeSecurityGroups.description_en: Queries details about created security groups
DescribeSecurityGroups.description_zh: 调用DescribeSecurityGroups查询已创建的安全组的基本信息

DescribeSelfImages.description_zh: 调用DescribeSelfImages查询自定义镜像列表

DescribeServcieSchedule.description_en: You can call the DescribeServcieSchedule to query the real-time status of the instance device or container that is being occupied by the UUID
DescribeServcieSchedule.description_zh: 调用DescribeServcieSchedule查询Uuid正在占用的（调度中）实例设备或容器实时状态

DescribeServerLoadBalancerListenMonitor.description_en: Queries listener-level monitoring data for an ESLB instance

DescribeServerLoadBalancerMonitor.description_en: Queries request monitoring data of an ESLB instance

DescribeSnapshots.description_en: Queries snapshot information by calling DescribeSnapshots

DescribeSnatAttribute.description_en: Queries a specific source network address translation (SNAT) entry
DescribeSnatAttribute.description_zh: 调用DescribeSnatAttribute查询指定SNAT规则的明细信息

DescribeSnatTableEntries.description_en: Queries source network address translation (SNAT) entries
DescribeSnatTableEntries.description_zh: 调用DescribeSnatTableEntries查询已创建的SNAT条目

DescribeUserBandWidthData.description_en: Queries the bandwidth that you use within a specified period of time
DescribeUserBandWidthData.description_zh: 调用DescribeUserBandWidthData查询用户在指定时间段内使用的带宽信息

DescribeVSwitchAttributes.description_en: Call the DescribeVSwitchAttributes operation to query the configuration of a specified vSwitch
DescribeVSwitchAttributes.description_zh: 调用DescribeVSwitchAttributes接口查询指定交换机的配置信息

DescribeVSwitches.description_zh: 调用DescribeVSwitches查询可组网的信息，内网按vswitch进行组网

DetachDisk.description_en: Detaches a pay-as-you-go disk from an Edge Node Service (ENS) instance. You cannot To detach a disk that is created together with an instance
DetachDisk.description_zh: 调用DetachDisk从一台ENS实例上卸载一块按量付费数据盘，仅支持卸载按量付费（单独购买）的磁盘，不支持随实例创建的磁盘

DetachKeyPair.description_en: Detaches a key pair from up to 30 instances in a single request. You can specify the key pair by its key pair name or key pair ID
DetachKeyPair.description_zh: 从最多30台实例中批量解绑指定的密钥对，支持通过密钥对名或ID操作

DetachNetworkInterface.description_en: Detach an elastic network interface (ENI) from an instance
DetachNetworkInterface.description_zh: 调用DetachNetworkInterface从一台实例上卸载一个弹性网卡（ENI）

DistApplicationData.description_en: Distributes pushed data to the Edge Node Service (ENS) instances of the application. You can specify multiple canary release policies, decompress files, and restart containers
DistApplicationData.description_zh: 调用DistApplicationData分发已预推成功的数据到应用的边缘资源实例，目标边缘资源的范围支持多种灰度策略，同时支持文件解压缩与容器重启

EventMigrateInstance.description_en: Migrates an instance across physical nodes in response to an O&M event
EventMigrateInstance.description_zh: 实例发生运维事件后，对实例进行跨节点迁移操作

EventRebootInstance.description_en: Reboots an Instance affected by an Operational Event
EventRebootInstance.description_zh: 实例发生运维事件后，对实例进行重启操作

EventRedeployInstance.description_en: Redeploys a specified instance either immediately or at a scheduled time
EventRedeployInstance.description_zh: 用于立即或预约重新部署指定资源的事件

ExportBillDetailData.description_en: Exports billing details within a specific time range
ExportBillDetailData.description_zh: 调用ExportBillDetailData导出账单明细数据

ExportImage.description_en: Exports a custom image to an Object Storage Service (OSS) bucket in the same region
ExportImage.description_zh: 调用ExportImage导出一份自定义镜像到与该自定义镜像同一地域的OSS Bucket里

ExportMeasurementData.description_en: Exports the metering data within a specific time range
ExportMeasurementData.description_zh: 调用ExportMeasurementData导出用户计量数据

GetBucketAcl.description_en: Queries the access control list (ACL) of a bucket

GetBucketInfo.description_en: You can call GetBucketInfo to retrieve detailed Bucket information

GetBucketLifecycle.description_en: Call GetBucketLifecycle to retrieve lifecycle rule information
GetBucketLifecycle.description_zh: 调用GetBucketLifecycle获取生命周期规则信息

GetClusterAddonInstance.description_en: Call the GetClusterAddonInstance operation to query the details of a component in a cluster, including the version, parameter settings, and status of the component instance
GetClusterAddonInstance.description_zh: 您可以调用GetClusterAddonInstance接口查询集群中目标组件的详细信息，包括目标组件实例的版本、参数配置、启用状态等

GetOssStorageAndAccByBuckets.description_en: Queries the storage usage in the previous billing cycle and the cumulative number of calls in this month
GetOssStorageAndAccByBuckets.description_zh: 调用GetOssStorageAndAccByBuckets查询上一计费周期存储用量和本月累计调用次数

GetOssUsageData.description_en: Queries the storage and bandwidth usage within a specific time range
GetOssUsageData.description_zh: 调用GetOssUsageData查询时间段内的存储、带宽用量的计算值

ImportKeyPair.description_en: Imports the public key of a Rivest–Shamir–Adleman (RSA)-encrypted key pair that is generated by a third-party tool
ImportKeyPair.description_zh: 调用ImportKeyPair导入由其他工具产生的RSA密钥对的公钥部分

InitializeENSECKServiceRole.description_en: Creates a service-linked role (SLR) that grants ENS the permissions to manage your resources
InitializeENSECKServiceRole.description_zh: 为当前用户创建ENS的服务关联角色（SLR），管控资源

InstallClusterAddons.description_en: To enhance the capabilities of Kubernetes, Edge Kubernetes (ECK) clusters support a variety of components, such as managed core components, applications, logging and monitoring, networking, storage, and security components. You can call the InstallClusterAddons operation to install components by specifying their names and versions
InstallClusterAddons.description_zh: 为了增强Kubernetes能力，ECK集群支持了多种组件，例如托管的核心组件，应用、日志和监控、网络、存储、安全组件等。您可以调用InstallClusterAddons接口，通过组件名称和版本安装组件

JoinPublicIpsToEpnInstance.description_en: Assigns public IP addresses to an EPN instance
JoinPublicIpsToEpnInstance.description_zh: 调用JoinPublicIpsToEpnInstance添加公网实例组网，仅公网模式可调用

JoinSecurityGroup.description_en: Adds an Edge Node Service (ENS) instance to a specified security group
JoinSecurityGroup.description_zh: 调用JoinSecurityGroup将一台ENS实例加入到指定的安全组

LeaveSecurityGroup.description_en: Removes an instance from a security group
LeaveSecurityGroup.description_zh: 调用LeaveSecurityGroup将一台ENS实例移出指定的安全组

ListAICPublicKeyDeliveries.description_en: Queries the related information of AIC public keys. Paged query is supported
ListAICPublicKeyDeliveries.description_zh: 查询AIC公钥的关联信息列表，支持分页查询

ListAICPublicKeys.description_en: Query the list of AIC public keys that meet the conditions. Paged query is supported
ListAICPublicKeys.description_zh: 查询满足条件的AIC公钥信息列表，支持分页查询

ListAddons.description_zh: 查询集群组件的详细信息

ListApplications.description_zh: 调用ListApplications列出创建的应用列表

ListBuckets.description_en: Queries all buckets of a user
ListBuckets.description_zh: 调用ListBuckets查询指定用户拥有的所有存储空间（Bucket）

ListClusterAddonInstances.description_en: Retrieves a list of add-on instances installed in a destination cluster and returns information such as their version and status
ListClusterAddonInstances.description_zh: 获取目标集群已安装的组件实例列表并查询组件实例的相关信息，包括组件版本、状态等

ListObjects.description_en: Queries the information about all objects in a bucket
ListObjects.description_zh: 调用ListObjects列出Bucket中的所有文件（Object）的信息

ListTagResources.description_en: Queries tags that are added to Edge Node Service (ENS) instances
ListTagResources.description_zh: 查询一个或多个ENS资源（目前只支持实例资源）已经绑定的标签列表

ManageAICLogin.description_en: Log on to the AIC instance. You can associate or disassociate an AIC instance based on the uploaded AIC public key
ManageAICLogin.description_zh: AIC实例登录管理，可基于上传的AIC公钥进行实例关联或者取消关联

ModifyAICInstanceType.description_en: Modifies the specifications of an Android in Container (AIC) instance

ModifyClusterAddon.description_en: Call the ModifyClusterAddon operation to modify the configuration of an installed cluster component. Modifying the configuration may affect your services. We recommend that you assess the impact, perform this operation during off-peak hours, and back up your data in advance
ModifyClusterAddon.description_zh: 您可以调用ModifyClusterAddon配置修改已安装的集群组件实例的配置。修改配置可能会影响业务，请评估影响后在业务低峰期操作并提前做好相关的数据备份

ModifyClusterNodePool.description_en: You can call the ModifyClusterNodePool operation to modify node configurations in a cluster node pool, such as kubelet and node rotation configurations. Modifies configurations in batches and restarts the kubelet, which may affect node and workload operations. Perform this operation during off-peak hours
ModifyClusterNodePool.description_zh: 您可以调用ModifyNodePoolNodeConfig接口修改集群节点池中节点配置信息，例如kubelet配置、节点轮转配置等。修改节点配置会按批次变更节点配置并重启kubelet, 可能会对节点运行和工作负载运行产生一定影响，请在业务低峰期操作

ModifyEnsEipAddressAttribute.description_en: Modifies the name, description, and peak bandwidth of a specified elastic IP address (EIP)
ModifyEnsEipAddressAttribute.description_zh: 调用ModifyEnsEipAddressAttribute修改指定EIP的名称、描述信息和带宽峰值

ModifyEnsRouteEntry.description_en: Modifies the name and description of a custom route
ModifyEnsRouteEntry.description_zh: 调用ModifyEnsRouteEntry接口修改自定义路由条目名称、描述

ModifyEpnInstance.description_en: Modifies an Edge Private Network (EPN) instance
ModifyEpnInstance.description_zh: 调用ModifyEpnInstance修改边边通信实例

ModifyFileSystem.description_en: Modifies the description of a NAS file system
ModifyFileSystem.description_zh: 调用ModifyFileSystem修改NAS文件系统的描述信息

ModifyForwardEntry.description_en: Modifies a Destination Network Address Translation (DNAT) rule

ModifyHaVipAttribute.description_en: Modifies the name of a high-availability virtual IP address (HAVIP)
ModifyHaVipAttribute.description_zh: 调用ModifyHaVipAttribute接口修改HaVip实例的名称

ModifyImageAttribute.description_zh: 调用ModifyImageAttribute修改镜像属性信息

ModifyImageSharePermission.description_zh: 调用ModifyImageSharePermission共享镜像或取消共享镜像

ModifyInstanceAttribute.description_en: Modifies the attributes of an instance, such as its password and name
ModifyInstanceAttribute.description_zh: 调用ModifyInstanceAttribute修改实例属性，包括实例密码、名称

ModifyInstanceBootConfiguration.description_en: Modifies the boot configuration of a heterogeneous PC Farm bare metal instance
ModifyInstanceBootConfiguration.description_zh: 修改启动配置，只支持异构实例（PCFarm裸金属）

ModifyInstanceChargeType.description_en: Invokes ModifyInstanceChargeType to convert the billing method of one or more Edge Node Service (ENS) instances. You can convert between instance-level pay-as-you-go and subscription instances. For instance-level pay-as-you-go instances, you can also convert pay-as-you-go cloud disks created with the instances to subscription cloud disks
ModifyInstanceChargeType.description_zh: 调用ModifyInstanceChargeType更换一台或者多台ENS实例的计费方式。支持在实例级后付费实例和包年包月实例间相互转换，同时针对实例级后付费实例可以将随实例创建的后付费云盘转换为包年包月云盘

ModifyInstanceNetworkAttribute.description_en: Modifies the private IP address or vSwitch of a VPC-type ECS instance
ModifyInstanceNetworkAttribute.description_zh: 修改一台ENS实例的私网IP地址、交换机

ModifyLoadBalancerAttribute.description_en: Modifies the information about an Edge Load Balancer (ELB) instance
ModifyLoadBalancerAttribute.description_zh: 调用ModifyLoadBalancerAttribute修改一个负载均衡实例的信息

ModifyNetworkInterfaceAttribute.description_en: Modifies the attributes of an elastic network interface (ENI), such as its name and description
ModifyNetworkInterfaceAttribute.description_zh: 调用ModifyNetworkInterfaceAttribute修改一个弹性网卡（ENI）的名称、描述等信息

ModifyPrepayInstanceSpec.description_en: Calls ModifyPrepayInstanceSpec to upgrade or downgrade the instance type of a subscription ENS instance. The new instance type takes effect for the entire lifecycle of the instance
ModifyPrepayInstanceSpec.description_zh: 调用ModifyPrepayInstanceSpec升级或者降低一台包年包月ENS实例的实例规格，新实例规格将会覆盖实例的整个生命周期

ModifySecurityGroupAttribute.description_en: Modifies the information about a security group
ModifySecurityGroupAttribute.description_zh: 调用ModifySecurityGroupAttribute修改一个安全组的安全组信息

ModifySnapshotAttribute.description_en: Modifies the information about a snapshot

ModifySnatEntry.description_en: Invoke the ModifySnatEntry API to modify an SNAT entry

ModifyVSwitchAttribute.description_en: Call ModifyVSwitchAttribute to modify network information

MountInstanceSDG.description_en: Deploys the SDG that has been attached to instances on the corresponding Android in Container (AIC) instance
MountInstanceSDG.description_zh: 将已经attach在instance上的SDG实际部署到对应的AIC

PrepareUpload.description_en: Prepares for an upload and retrieves information about the physical storage location
PrepareUpload.description_zh: 准备上传，获取物理存储位置信息

PushApplicationData.description_en: Pushes the business or service data of an application to file servers
PushApplicationData.description_zh: 调用PushApplicationData预推应用的业务/服务类数据到文件服务器

PutBucket.description_en: Create a bucket for collaborative storage
PutBucket.description_zh: 创建协同存储的Bucket存储空间

PutBucketAcl.description_en: Modifies the access control list (ACL) of a bucket

PutBucketLifecycle.description_en: You can call the PutBucketLifecycle operation to set lifecycle rules for a bucket
PutBucketLifecycle.description_zh: 调用PutBucketLifecycle设置文件生命周期规则

RebootAICInstance.description_en: Restarts an Android in Container (AIC) instance

RebootARMServerInstance.description_en: Reboots an Android in Container (AIC) server

RecoverAICInstance.description_en: Recovers an Android in Container (AIC) instance on the server

ReinitInstance.description_en: Resets an instance based on specific parameters
ReinitInstance.description_zh: 按照指定的参数重置实例到初始状态

ReleaseAICInstance.description_en: Releases an Android in Container (AIC) instance from the server

ReleaseARMServerInstance.description_zh: 调用ReleaseARMServerInstance释放一台云应用服务器

ReleaseInstance.description_en: Releases an instance. to release only Elastic IP Addresses (EIPs), Edge Load Balancer (ELB) instances, and cloud disk-based instances. We recommend that you call service-specific operations to release or unsubscribe from instances
ReleaseInstance.description_zh:
释放实例，此接口只支持弹性公网EIP、边缘负载均衡实例ELB、云盘实例释放。建议对实例的释放调用每个产品对应的释放或退订接口。
释放EIP接口：DeleteEip，释放ELB接口：DeleteLoadBalancer，释放云盘实例接口：DeleteDisk

ReleasePostPaidInstance.description_zh: 调用ReleasePostPaidInstance删除按量付费实例

ReleasePrePaidInstance.description_en: Call ReleasePrePaidInstance to delete a subscription instance

RemoveBackendServers.description_en: Removes backend servers from a Server Load Balancer (SLB) instance

RemoveInstanceSDG.description_en: Removes a shared data group (SDG) that is attached to the compute instance
RemoveInstanceSDG.description_zh: 移除计算实例上已挂载的SDG

RemovePublicIpsFromEpnInstance.description_en: Removes IP addresses from an edge private network (EPN) instance
RemovePublicIpsFromEpnInstance.description_zh: 调用RemovePublicIpsFromEpnInstance删除公网组网下的实例

RemoveSDG.description_en: Removes a deployed shared data group (SDG) and restore local storage
RemoveSDG.description_zh: 调用 RemoveSDG移除部署的SDG，恢复本地存储

RemoveSDGs.description_en: Removes all versions of SDG and restores the mount to the local disk
RemoveSDGs.description_zh: 可移除所有版本的sdg，恢复为本地盘挂载

RemoveVSwitchesFromEpnInstance.description_en: Deletes the networking information. This operation is applicable only for instances that reside in the internal network
RemoveVSwitchesFromEpnInstance.description_zh: 调用RemoveVSwitchesFromEpnInstance进行组网信息删除，针对内网有效

RenewARMServerInstance.description_en: Renews a subscription Android in Container (AIC) instance
RenewARMServerInstance.description_zh: 调用RenewARMServerInstance续费一台包年包月AIC实例

RenewInstance.description_zh: 调用RenewInstance给预付费实例续费

RescaleApplication.description_en: Calls the RescaleApplication operation to asynchronously scale resources in or out and complete container deployment or release operations
RescaleApplication.description_zh: 调用RescaleApplication异步执行资源扩/缩容，并完成容器部署/释放操作

RescaleDeviceService.description_en: Scales out a bare metal device
RescaleDeviceService.description_zh: 调用RescaleDeviceService执行裸金属设备的扩容

ResetDisk.description_en: Rolls back a disk by using a snapshot

ResizeDisk.description_en: Resizes a pay-as-you-go disk that you purchase
ResizeDisk.description_zh: 调用ResizeDisk针对单独购买的后付费云盘实例进行扩容

RevokeSecurityGroup.description_en: Revokes an inbound rule of a security group to remove the inbound access permission settings
RevokeSecurityGroup.description_zh: 调用RevokeSecurityGroup删除一条安全组入方向规则，撤销安全组入方向的权限设置

RevokeSecurityGroupEgress.description_en: Calls RevokeSecurityGroupEgress to delete an outbound security group rule and revoke outbound access permissions of the security group
RevokeSecurityGroupEgress.description_zh: 调用RevokeSecurityGroupEgress删除一条出方向安全组规则，撤销安全组出方向的访问权限

RollbackApplication.description_en: Rolls back the container version of a specific application
RollbackApplication.description_zh: 调用RollbackApplication回滚应用下边缘资源的容器版本，回退到历史版本

RunInstances.description_en: Creates pay-as-you-go or subscription ENS compute instances
RunInstances.description_zh: 创建按量付费或包年包月的ENS计算实例

RunServiceSchedule.description_en: Schedules the nearest idle resources including instances and pods for your device based on the user ID and IP address and initializes the virtual environment
RunServiceSchedule.description_zh: 调用RunServiceSchedule根据客户ID&IP基本信息，为终端设备最优调度空闲资源（实例设备/容器POD），并完成虚拟设备环境的初始化

SaveSDG.description_en: Saves the disk of a specific device as a shared data group (SDG)
SaveSDG.description_zh: 调用SaveSDG将指定设备的云盘保存为SDG

ScaleClusterNodePool.description_en: Call the ScaleClusterNodePool operation to scale out a node pool, which adds more nodes to support your workloads. The count parameter must be greater than the current number of nodes in the pool. If a node pool contains failed nodes, first call the DeleteClusterNodes operation to remove them before scaling out the pool. A scale-out operation typically completes in 5 to 10 minutes. If the operation takes longer than one hour, it has failed. Contact technical support
ScaleClusterNodePool.description_zh:
您可以调用ScaleClusterNodePool对节点进行扩容，以保证节点数量足够支撑业务运行。
count 参数必需大于当前节点池的节点数。如果节点池中存在扩容失败的 node（failed node），则必需使用 DeleteClusterNodes 接口删除对应 node 后进行扩容。
节点扩容正常耗时在5-10分钟内，超过1小时为扩容失败，请联系技术支持

SetBackendServers.description_en: Sets the weights of backend servers by calling SetBackendServers
SetBackendServers.description_zh: 调用SetBackendServers设置后端服务器权重

SetLoadBalancerHTTPListenerAttribute.description_en: Modifies the configuration of an HTTP listener

SetLoadBalancerStatus.description_en: Modifies the status of an Edge Load Balancer (ELB) instance
SetLoadBalancerStatus.description_zh: 调用SetLoadBalancerStatus修改负载均衡实例状态

SetLoadBalancerTCPListenerAttribute.description_en: Modifies the configuration of a TCP listener

SetLoadBalancerUDPListenerAttribute.description_en: Call `SetLoadBalancerUDPListenerAttribute` to modify a UDP listener

ShareAICImage.description_en: Share the specified AIC image to other users
ShareAICImage.description_zh: 共享指定的AIC镜像给到其他用户

StartEpnInstance.description_zh: 调用StartEpnInstance启动边边通信实例

StartSnatIpForSnatEntry.description_en: Starts the elastic IP address (EIP) specified in a source network address translation (SNAT) entry

StopEpnInstance.description_zh: 调用StopEpnInstance停止边边通信实例

StopInstance.description_zh: 调用StopInstance停止运行一台实例

StopSnatIpForSnatEntry.description_en: Disables an elastic IP address (EIP) in a source network address translation (SNAT) entry

TagResources.description_en: Creates and adds tags to specific Edge Node Service (ENS) resources
TagResources.description_zh: 调用TagResources为指定的ENS资源列表统一创建并绑定标签

UnAssociateEnsEipAddress.description_en: Disassociates an elastic IP address (EIP) from the cloud resource to which it is bound
UnAssociateEnsEipAddress.description_zh: 调用UnAssociateEnsEipAddress将弹性公网IP（EIP）从绑定的云产品上解绑

UnInstallClusterAddons.description_en: The UnInstallClusterAddons operation deletes components from a cluster. You must specify the names of the components that you want to delete
UnInstallClusterAddons.description_zh: 当您无需使用集群某些组件时，您可以调用UnInstallClusterAddons接口指定组件名称，删除组件

UnassignPrivateIpAddresses.description_en: Unassigns secondary private IP addresses from an elastic network interface (ENI)
UnassignPrivateIpAddresses.description_zh: 调用UnassignPrivateIpAddresses从一块网卡删除一个或多个辅助私有IP地址

UnassociateHaVip.description_en: Disassociates a high-availability virtual IP address (HAVIP) from an Edge Node Service (ENS) instance or Elastic Network Interface (ENI)
UnassociateHaVip.description_zh: 调用UnassociateHaVip 接口将HaVip与ENS实例或弹性网卡解绑

UnassociateNetworkAcl.description_en: Disassociates a network access control list (ACL) from a network
UnassociateNetworkAcl.description_zh: 调用UnassociateNetworkAcl接口，解绑定网络ACL与网络
